evidence: extension/fixtures/suno/ (generate-v2-web.<mode>.response.json, feed-v3.<mode>.response.json); request bodies are described in extension/fixtures/suno/README.md

pathRoots.feed: one clip in `clips[]` of the response to POST /api/feed/v3 (what import reads)
pathRoots.create: one clip in `clips[]` of the response to POST /api/generate/v2-web/ (what the observed-Create story reads)
pathRoots.createRequest: the JSON body of POST /api/generate/v2-web/; readable only by a page-side wrapper in the tab that clicked Create

kindMarkers.sound: metadata.task === "sound" (model_name chirp-sfx in the feed, chirp-seeds in the Create response; major_model_version is empty)

modeMarkers.simple: metadata.gpt_description_prompt is present and metadata.task === "agentic_thinking" (feed and create); createRequest.metadata.create_mode === "simple"
modeMarkers.advanced: metadata.gpt_description_prompt is absent; createRequest.metadata.create_mode === "custom" (Sounds also sends "custom")
modeMarkers.note: A clip with a TS-002 lineage task (cover, extend, …) is marked by that task instead; create_mode is never returned in feed or create.

values.v6-wild: unverified (the trash page shows a V6-WILD badge)

model.notes: Songs only; Speech clips carry no badge. model_name (chirp-goose) and major_model_version (v6) are the same for every model label seen, so neither identifies the label. createRequest.mv was chirp-goose for v6-mini; other labels were not exercised.

simple_prompt.example: short upbeat acoustic folk tune about a test

simple_add_lyrics.unverified: Not exercised. Expected in metadata.prompt, as in Advanced mode.

notReturned.checked: Unverified in TS-003: no Simple clip with the lyrics section added was captured, and the feed has no field saying a section was added.

simple_add_styles.unverified: Not exercised. Expected in metadata.tags, which the feed rewrites (see styles).

notReturned.checked: Unverified in TS-003: no Simple clip with the styles section added was captured, and the feed has no field saying a section was added.

simple_add_playlist.notes: Lineage per TS-002 (playlist_condition); in the Create response playlist_id is the literal "inspiration". Not re-exercised in TS-003.

notReturned.checked: Not exercised; feed and Create response carry no image input field (image_url is Suno's generated cover). createRequest.user_uploaded_images_b64 was null in every run.
Not exercised; no video input field in any captured body (video_url is Suno's output, empty for every clip).

audio.notes: Source identifiers per action are listed in docs/spikes/TS-002.md. createRequest carries cover_clip_id, artist_clip_id, continue_clip_id and their start/end seconds, all null for plain generations.

voice.notes: Per TS-002. The top-level persona object also names the persona.

lyrics.notes: Returned unchanged. For a Simple-mode clip, metadata.prompt holds the lyrics Suno wrote, not user input.

notReturned.checked: feed metadata.tags holds Suno's rewritten style description ("acoustic folk, banjo" came back as a 205-character description), not the submitted text; display_tags is a short genre summary ("folk, acoustic"). Only the Create response and request hold the submitted value.
Every key of the finished clip and its metadata in the feed, and the Create response clip.
feed metadata.duration is the measured length of the audio (29.6 and 30.28 for a 30-second request), not the setting.
As duration_mode. The Custom slider moves in 5-second steps from 10 to 360.

max_mode.notes: Exercised on v6-mini, where Suno accepted it.

weirdness.notes: Form 70 is sent as 0.7. Absent when left at the default 50 (Songs Simple).

variety.notes: High (2) and Max (4) were seen; Off, Normal, and Extra follow their order on the form (unverified). Songs Simple also sent aug_creativity (4, the Advanced form's value at the time), so a Simple clip carries the Advanced form's Variety.

notReturned.checked: Every key of the finished clip and its metadata, and the Create response clip.

title.notes: Top-level on the clip. A blank title is replaced by one Suno writes, so on import a title cannot be told apart from a submitted one.

workspace.notes: The Create response clip has no project; project.name also comes with the feed clip.

sound_description.notes: Unlike Songs and Speech, Suno keeps the submitted text for Sounds. The page also sends it, title-cased, as the title.

sound_bpm.notes: Auto (empty) is unverified, expected absent. metadata.avg_bpm is Suno's measurement (82 for a 120 request) and is not the setting.

sound_key.notes: Key and scale share one string: note name, then m for minor. metadata.key (e.g. Ab_minor) is Suno's measurement.
